Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here's what we can do together:

🤖 Poses
"Make the robot stand in a relaxed pose."
"Raise both arms to wave hello."
"Sit the robot down on a chair."

✋ Hands
"Close the left hand into a fist."
"Open the right hand to point forward."
"Tap the left thumb against the palm."

🎬 Simulation
"Walk forward across the room."
"Turn the torso left while stepping."
"Perform a quick crouch and rise."

⌨️ Code & Controls
"Add keyboard shortcuts to control arm movements."
"Implement a simple walking controller in JavaScript."
"Create a GUI slider to adjust wrist rotation."

I'm your co-pilot for the **Unitree G1**, ready to help you build, pose, animate, and control your robot. Just tell me what you'd like to do and we'll bring it to life together! 🚀
add a table into the scene

All clean! ✅ The fix was simple — renamed the texture from `"grid"` to `"grid_tex"` so it no longer clashes with the material named `"grid"`. The table is now in your scene at position `(1.2, 0, 0)` with a wooden-toned tabletop and four legs.
